title: Mediterranean Chicken Wraps with Feta, Red Pepper and Olives
summary: Chicken breast is poached off the heat to 74 °C, shredded and tossed with feta, Greek yoghurt, red pepper, olives, shallot and lemon, then rolled in warmed tortillas with rocket.

ingredients.item: large red pepper, cut into thin strips
fine sea salt or table salt
large flour tortillas, about 25 cm (about 240 g)

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Bring the chicken to a bare simmer in cold water, cover and leave off the heat until it reads 74 °C.

steps.title: Shred
steps.text: Cool 10 minutes and shred with two forks.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Toss with the feta, yoghurt, pepper, olives, shallot, lemon, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Warm
steps.text: Heat the tortillas briefly in a dry pan.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Add leaves and filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Wrap in paper, halve and serve.

tips: Off-heat poaching keeps the chicken juicy.
Leftover roast chicken works well in place of poached.
storage: Refrigerate the filling for up to 2 days; assemble wraps on the day. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
